semQlEnricherExpressions.expression: CASE WHEN (FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL OR SourceID_Cgid IS NOT NULL) THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(RegistrationNo, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ELSE RegistrationNoNormalised END

CASE
  WHEN NOT (FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL OR SourceID_Cgid IS NOT NULL) THEN CASE WHEN IsPlaceholder = '1' THEN '1' WHEN IsPlaceholder = '0' THEN '0' END
  WHEN RegistrationNo IS NULL THEN '0'
  WHEN UPPER(BTRIM(RegistrationNo)) IN ('NA', 'N/A', 'NIL', 'NONE', 'NULL', 'TBD', 'TEST', 'XXX') THEN '1'
  WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(RegistrationNo, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) < 4 THEN '1'
  WHEN REPLACE(BTRIM(RegistrationNo), LEFT(BTRIM(RegistrationNo), 1), '') = '' THEN '1'
  WHEN BTRIM(RegistrationNo) = LEFT('123456789012345678901234567890', LENGTH(BTRIM(RegistrationNo))) THEN '1'
  ELSE '0'
END

CASE
  WHEN NOT (FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL OR SourceID_Cgid IS NOT NULL) THEN CASE WHEN FormatValid = '1' THEN '1' WHEN FormatValid = '0' THEN '0' END
  WHEN RegistrationNo IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REGEXP_REPLACE(RegistrationNo, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '^100[0-9]{12}$') AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(RegistrationNo, '[A-Za-z]') THEN '1'
  ELSE '0'
END

CASE
  WHEN NOT (FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL OR SourceID_Cgid IS NOT NULL) THEN CASE WHEN IsCurrent = '1' THEN '1' WHEN IsCurrent = '0' THEN '0' END
  WHEN EndDate IS NULL OR EndDate >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN '1'
  ELSE '0'
END
CASE WHEN EndDate IS NULL OR EndDate >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

Used by MAT-17 to keep non-trade payees out of the name rules.
enrichers.label: Derive Non-Trade Payee

semQlEnricherExpressions.expression:
CASE
  WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(NameAlternate, ''))), '^(house loan|car loan|not supplier.*|court order.*|intercompany|maritime academy student.*)$') THEN 'Y'
  WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(COALESCE(NameEn, '')), 'petty cash|cash in hand|end of service|employee|loan supplier') THEN 'Y'
  ELSE COALESCE(NonTradeFlag, 'N')
END

CASE

            'AAAAAAaaaaaaEEEEeeeeIIIIiiiiOOOOOoooooUUUUuuuuCcNn')),

        ),

enrichers.description: Builds the keys used by MAT-01/MAT-09 (TrnMatchKey from the Fusion VAT registration number), MAT-14 (WebsiteDomain) and MAT-08 (NameTokenKey: first three name tokens sorted, remaining tokens appended).
enrichers.label: Derive Supplier Match Keys

semQlEnricherExpressions.expression:
CASE
  WHEN VATRegistrationNumber IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(VATRegistrationNumber, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) < 8 THEN NULL
  WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REGEXP_REPLACE(VATRegistrationNumber, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'), '^(.)\1+$') THEN NULL
  WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(VATRegistrationNumber, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') = LEFT('123456789012345678901234567890', LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(VATRegistrationNumber, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'))) THEN NULL
  ELSE UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(VATRegistrationNumber, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'))
END

CASE
  WHEN Website IS NULL OR STRPOS(Website, '@') > 0 THEN NULL
  WHEN STRPOS(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(BTRIM(Website)), '^[a-z]+://', ''), '^www[0-9]*\.|[/:?#].*$', '', 'g'), '.') = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(BTRIM(Website)), '^[a-z]+://', ''), '^www[0-9]*\.|[/:?#].*$', '', 'g')
END

CASE
  WHEN NameMatchKey IS NULL OR BTRIM(NameMatchKey) = '' THEN NULL
  ELSE BTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
    LEAST(SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1), SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2), SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
    || ' ' ||
    CASE
      WHEN (SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) >= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) AND SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) <= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
        OR (SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) <= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) AND SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) >= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
        THEN SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1)
      WHEN (SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) >= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) AND SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) <= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
        OR (SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) <= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1) AND SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2) >= SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
        THEN SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2)
      ELSE SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3)
    END
    || ' ' ||
    GREATEST(SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 1), SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 2), SPLIT_PART(NameMatchKey, ' ', 3))
    || ' ' ||
    REGEXP_REPLACE(BTRIM(NameMatchKey), '^\S+( \S+){0,2} ?', ''),
    '\s+', ' ', 'g'))
END

AND Record2.AccountName IS NOT NULL

AND Record1.FID_Sgid = Record2.FID_Sgid

enrichers.description: Reads every customer UCID in Duplicate Customers (golden record with a suggested merge, state C01; all its master UCIDs) and returns them as record text for the self-call, plus the count. Semarchy wraps a STRING input in quotes without escaping, so the text has no leading and trailing quote: the MdmSelfLoad request body template completes it into valid JSON. Empty when there are no duplicates (no load is submitted).

pluginInputs.expression: 'ALL'

pluginParams.value: with lm as ( select distinct on (m.b_pubid, m.b_sourceid) m.b_sourceid ucid, m.customer_legal_account_id cgid from mi_custom_legal_account m order by m.b_pubid, m.b_sourceid, m.b_batchid desc ), d as ( select distinct on (lm.ucid) replace(lm.ucid, '"', '') ucid, cast(lm.cgid as bigint) cgid from lm join gd_custom_legal_account g on g.customer_legal_account_id = lm.cgid where g.sugg_match_score is not null and g.customer_state = 'C01' and lm.ucid is not null order by lm.ucid ), n as ( select d.ucid, d.cgid, row_number() over (order by d.ucid) rn, count(*) over () cnt from d ) select 'ALL' LOOKUP_COLUMN, string_agg(case when n.rn = 1 then n.ucid else '"},{"OutstandingKey":"' || n.ucid end || '","FID_Cgid":' || n.cgid || ',"RecordType":"RESULT', '' order by n.rn) OUTPUT_COLUMN1, cast(count(*) as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN2 from n

atomicAttributes.description: NOT_REQUIRED (not merged or single cluster), PENDING (cluster approval open), CONFIRMED. Set by EvaluateMergeDecision. SyncCustomer and CustomerMerge do not publish PENDING records.

atomicAttributes.description: Number of masters (merged customers) of the composition requested / approved. A merge that changes it requests a new approval.

atomicAttributes.description: Batch in which the merge approval was requested. ClusterMergeApproval starts only for records whose request is in the batch just completed.

atomicAttributes.description: Number of master records consolidated into this golden record (enricher ResolveMastersCount). Used to detect a merge.
atomicAttributes.label: Masters Count (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Merge approval status published before this batch (enricher ResolveMastersCount, read from the golden table). Used by EvaluateMergeDecision so that an approval already requested or confirmed is kept.
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Merge Approval Status (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Approval masters count published before this batch (enricher ResolveMastersCount).
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Approval Masters Count (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Approval request batch published before this batch (enricher ResolveMastersCount).
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Approval Request Batch (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Approval requester published before this batch (enricher ResolveMastersCount).
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Approval Requested By (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: When the merge that requested the cluster approval was done (EvaluateMergeDecision). Shown as Task Assigned On for the cluster review tasks.
atomicAttributes.label: Merge Done On

atomicAttributes.description: Full name and steward cluster(s) of the user who did the merge (EvaluateMergeDecision), shown to the reviewers.
atomicAttributes.label: Merged By

atomicAttributes.description: Published ApprovalRequestedOn before this batch (ResolveMastersCount), text YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Merge Done On (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Published ApprovalRequestedByInfo before this batch (ResolveMastersCount).
atomicAttributes.label: Previous Merged By (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Outcome of the decisions of the running approval round, including the Merge Approval Log rows submitted in the same batch (ResolveCycleDecision): GROUP_REVIEW (Group Steward Reject / Remerge) or CONFIRMED. Empty = no decision in this batch.
atomicAttributes.label: Cycle Outcome (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Latest decision time of the running approval round, YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS (ResolveCycleDecision).
atomicAttributes.label: Cycle Last Decision On (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Final decision of the running approval round: the Group Steward decision, otherwise the latest cluster decision (ResolveCycleDecision).
atomicAttributes.label: Cycle Final Decision (lookup)

atomicAttributes.description: Load (data set) of the merge approval workflow the review task belongs to; set when a reviewer opens the task (CaptureReviewContext enrichers).

atomicAttributes.description: Saved decision of the CO review in the current cycle, read from all parallel tasks (LookupReviewStatuses): C confirm, R reject, M remerge, empty = pending.
atomicAttributes.label: Review Status CO

atomicAttributes.description: Saved decision of the PT review in the current cycle, read from all parallel tasks (LookupReviewStatuses): C confirm, R reject, M remerge, empty = pending.
atomicAttributes.label: Review Status PT

atomicAttributes.description: Saved decision of the DC review in the current cycle, read from all parallel tasks (LookupReviewStatuses): C confirm, R reject, M remerge, empty = pending.
atomicAttributes.label: Review Status DC

atomicAttributes.description: Saved decision of the GS review in the current cycle, read from all parallel tasks (LookupReviewStatuses): C confirm, R reject, M remerge, empty = pending.
atomicAttributes.label: Review Status GS

atomicAttributes.description: When the opened review task was assigned: merge time for cluster reviews, last cluster decision for the Group Steward review (CaptureReviewContext enrichers).
atomicAttributes.label: Review Task Assigned On

atomicAttributes.description: Username of the user who did the merge that requested the approval (V_USERNAME of the merge batch). Used as initiator of ClusterMergeApproval.
atomicAttributes.label: Approval Requested By

atomicAttributes.description: Result of the outstanding-balance API call made when a steward merges this customer (CheckOutstandingOnMerge): true = outstanding found (merge blocked), false = clear. Overwritten on every merge attempt; not a balance.
atomicAttributes.label: Outstanding Check Result

matchRules.condition:
(
  Record1.NameMatchKey IS NOT NULL
  AND Record2.NameMatchKey IS NOT NULL
  AND Record1.LicenseNumber IS NOT NULL
  AND Record2.LicenseNumber IS NOT NULL
  AND Record1.FID_IssuingAuthorityCode IS NOT NULL
  AND Record2.FID_IssuingAuthorityCode IS NOT NULL
  AND Record1.FID_RegistrationCountry IS NOT NULL
  AND Record2.FID_RegistrationCountry IS NOT NULL
  AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.NameMatchKey)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.NameMatchKey))
  AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.LicenseNumber)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.LicenseNumber))
  AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.FID_IssuingAuthorityCode)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.FID_IssuingAuthorityCode))
  AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.FID_RegistrationCountry)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.FID_RegistrationCountry))
  AND (Record1.LicenseIsPlaceholder IS NULL OR Record1.LicenseIsPlaceholder = '0')
  AND (Record2.LicenseIsPlaceholder IS NULL OR Record2.LicenseIsPlaceholder = '0')
)
AND (Record1.Status IS NULL OR Record1.Status <> 'Inactive')
AND (Record2.Status IS NULL OR Record2.Status <> 'Inactive')
AND (Record1.IsBranch = '0' OR Record2.IsBranch = '0')
AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.NameEN)), '^([^A-Z\u0600-\u06FF]*|.{0,2}|TEST|MIS CUSTOMER|DUMMY|NA)$')
AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.NameEN)), '^([^A-Z\u0600-\u06FF]*|.{0,2}|TEST|MIS CUSTOMER|DUMMY|NA)$')
AND COALESCE(Record1.IsFreeZone, '0') = COALESCE(Record2.IsFreeZone, '0')
matchRules.description: The two records have the same English name, the same trade licence number, the same issuing authority and the same country of registration. Placeholder licence numbers are ignored. This is the strongest evidence that both records are the same legal entity.
matchRules.documentation: The two records have the same English name, the same trade licence number, the same issuing authority and the same country of registration. Placeholder licence numbers are ignored. This is the strongest evidence that both records are the same legal entity.

AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.NameEN)), '^([^A-Z\u0600-\u06FF]*|.{0,2}|TEST|MIS CUSTOMER|DUMMY|NA)$')
AND COALESCE(Record1.IsFreeZone, '0') = COALESCE(Record2.IsFreeZone, '0')
matchRules.description: Both records have the same trade licence number, the same issuing authority and the same country of registration, and the names are at least 85% alike. Placeholder licence numbers are ignored. A data steward reviews before merging.

AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.CustomerID.NameEN)), '^([^A-Z\u0600-\u06FF]*|.{0,2}|TEST|MIS CUSTOMER|DUMMY|NA)$')
AND COALESCE(Record1.CustomerID.IsFreeZone, '0') = COALESCE(Record2.CustomerID.IsFreeZone, '0')

  AND Record2.NameMatchKey IS NOT NULL
  AND SEM_EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY(UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.LicenseNumber)), UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.LicenseNumber))) > 90

  AND SEM_EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY(UPPER(Record1.NameMatchKey), UPPER(Record2.NameMatchKey)) > 90
)
AND (Record1.Status IS NULL OR Record1.Status <> 'Inactive')
AND (Record2.Status IS NULL OR Record2.Status <> 'Inactive')

AND COALESCE(Record1.IsFreeZone, '0') = COALESCE(Record2.IsFreeZone, '0')

    OR (Record1.BusinessPhone IS NOT NULL

    OR (Record1.Mobile IS NOT NULL
     AND REGEXP_REPLACE(Record1.Mobile, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = REGEXP_REPLACE(Record2.Mobile, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'))
    OR (Record1.EstablishmentAddress IS NOT NULL
     AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.EstablishmentAddress)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.EstablishmentAddress)))
  )
)

AND (Record1.IsBranch = '0' OR Record2.IsBranch = '0')

enrichers.description: For each cluster, the number of distinct ACTIVE business units over the department accounts (CustomerOrgAssignment) of ALL customers that share this customer's SuggestedMergeID (or the customer alone when it has no suggestion). A department account counts only when it is active (Status = A), its cluster (ClusterCode reference) is active, and its business unit is active and not linked to a different cluster (a business unit with no cluster in its reference data is accepted; the department links it to the cluster). NULL = no such department account for that cluster (cluster not involved). Read by DeriveApprovalClusters and EvaluateMergeDecision.
enrichers.label: Group Cluster BU Counts (department accounts, suggested merge group)

gd_custom_legal_account g ), dept as ( select gr.grp_key, case when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('MT', 'MARITIME') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('MT', 'MARITIME') then 'MT' when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('IZ', 'INDUSTRIAL ZONE') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('IZ', 'INDUSTRIAL ZONE') then 'IZ' when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('LGSTS', 'LOGISTICS') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('LGSTS', 'LOGISTICS') then 'LG' when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('CORP') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('CORP') then 'CO' when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('PORTS') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('PORTS') then 'PT' when upper(coalesce(c.cluster_code, '')) in ('DC', 'DIGITAL CLUSTER') or upper(coalesce(c.name_en, '')) in ('DC', 'DIGITAL CLUSTER') then 'DC' end clu, d.f_business_unit_code bu from gd_cust_org_assignment d join grp gr on gr.cgid = d.f_customer_legal and upper(coalesce(d.status, '')) = 'A' join gd_cluster c on c.cluster_code = d.f_cluster_code and lower(cast(c.is_active as varchar)) in ('true', 't', '1') join gd_business_unit b on b.business_unit_code = d.f_business_unit_code and (b.f_cluster_code is null or b.f_cluster_code = d.f_cluster_code) and lower(cast(b.is_active as varchar)) in ('true', 't', '1') ), agg as ( select grp_key, case when bool_or(clu = 'MT') then count(distinct case when clu = 'MT' then bu end) end mt, case when bool_or(clu = 'IZ') then count(distinct case when clu = 'IZ' then bu end) end iz, case when bool_or(clu = 'LG') then count(distinct case when clu = 'LG' then bu end) end lg, case when bool_or(clu = 'CO') then count(distinct case when clu = 'CO' then bu end) end co, case when bool_or(clu = 'PT') then count(distinct case when clu = 'PT' then bu end) end pt, case when bool_or(clu = 'DC') then count(distinct case when clu = 'DC' then bu end) end dc from dept group by grp_key ) select cast(g.cgid as varchar) LOOKUP_COLUMN, cast(a.mt as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN1, cast(a.iz as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN2, cast(a.lg as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN3, cast(a.co as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN4, cast(a.pt as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN5, cast(a.dc as varchar) OUTPUT_COLUMN6 from grp g left join agg a on a.grp_key = g.grp_key

pluginInputs.expression: '' || CustomerLegalAccountID

pluginParams.value: with d as ( select l.f_customer_legal_account_id cid, upper(l.cluster_code) cc, case upper(l.decision) when 'CONFIRMED' then 'C' when 'REJECTED' then 'R' else 'M' end st, row_number() over (partition by l.f_customer_legal_account_id, upper(l.cluster_code) order by l.decision_timestamp desc) rn from sa_merge_approval_logs l join gd_custom_legal_account g on g.customer_legal_account_id = l.f_customer_legal_account_id where upper(coalesce(l.decision, '')) in ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE') and (g.merge_decision_date is null or l.decision_timestamp > g.merge_decision_date) ) select cast(cid as varchar) LOOKUP_COLUMN, max(case when cc = 'MT' then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN1, max(case when cc = 'IZ' then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN2, max(case when cc in ('LG', 'LGSTS') then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN3, max(case when cc in ('CO', 'CORP') then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN4, max(case when cc in ('PT', 'PORTS') then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN5, max(case when cc = 'DC' then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN6, max(case when cc = 'GROUP' then st end) OUTPUT_COLUMN7 from d where rn = 1 group by cid

enrichers.description: Golden data is published only at the end of a job, so when ClusterMergeApproval submits the decisions together with the customer, EvaluateMergeDecision cannot see the new Merge Approval Log rows in the golden table. This lookup reads them from the source table of the same load (V_LOADID) plus the published rows, keeps the rows of the running round (after MergeDecisionDate) and returns the outcome: GROUP_REVIEW when the Group Steward chose Reject / Remerge, otherwise CONFIRMED; the latest decision time; and the final decision (Group Steward first, else the latest).
enrichers.label: Resolve Cycle Decision (decisions submitted in this batch)

pluginInputs.expression: '' || CustomerLegalAccountID || '|' || :V_LOADID

pluginParams.value: with cyc as ( select customer_legal_account_id cgid, merge_decision_date mdd from gd_custom_legal_account ), sa as ( select coalesce(s.f_customer_legal_account_id, (select m.customer_legal_account_id from mi_custom_legal_account m where m.b_pubid = s.fp_customer_legal_account_id and m.b_sourceid = s.fs_customer_legal_account_id order by m.b_batchid desc limit 1)) cgid, s.b_loadid lid, upper(s.cluster_code) cc, upper(trim(s.decision)) dec, s.decision_timestamp ts from sa_merge_approval_logs s ), cur as ( select distinct cgid, lid from sa where cgid is not null ), lg as ( select cgid, lid, cc, dec, ts from sa where cgid is not null union all select c.cgid, c.lid, upper(g.cluster_code), upper(trim(g.decision)), g.decision_timestamp from cur c join gd_merge_approval_logs g on g.f_customer_legal_account_id = c.cgid ), d as ( select lg.* from lg join cyc on cyc.cgid = lg.cgid where lg.dec in ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE') and lg.ts is not null and (cyc.mdd is null or lg.ts > cyc.mdd) ) select cast(cgid as varchar) || '|' || cast(lid as varchar) LOOKUP_COLUMN, case when bool_or(cc = 'GROUP' and dec in ('REJECTED', 'REMERGE')) then 'GROUP_REVIEW' else 'CONFIRMED' end OUTPUT_COLUMN1, to_char(max(ts), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') OUTPUT_COLUMN2, (array_agg(dec order by case when cc = 'GROUP' then 0 else 1 end, ts desc))[1] OUTPUT_COLUMN3 from d group by cgid, lid

enrichers.description: LkpMastersCount = number of master records whose latest version (master integration table) points to this golden record; used by EvaluateMergeDecision to detect a merge. enrichers.description: OutstandingCheckResult for the golden record from the Customer Outstanding RESULT rows of ALL its master UCIDs (independent of the reference, so it also works right after a merge): YES = any UCID has outstanding, REFRESH = any UCID never refreshed or check failed, NO = all clear. enrichers.description: Fills only values that arrived empty, never overwrites a received value. Emirate: when empty (and the country is empty or UAE), taken from the issuing authority - its code (AUTH-AE-AUH/DXB/SHJ/AJM/UAQ/RAK/FUJ-...) or else its name (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah). Country: when empty and an emirate was received or derived, set to UAE (AE). Free zone: set from the issuing authority (Abu Dhabi Free Zone, CRM code 399590000 / AbuDhabiFreeZone) so the match rules only match free zone customers with free zone customers. Runs before matching.
enrichers.label: Derive Registration Emirate, Country And Free Zone

enrichers.description: Decisions of the running round come from the Merge Approval Log rows (published) and from ResolveCycleDecision (rows submitted in the same batch, not yet published). Decision rows count only while an approval is running (previous status PENDING); a new approval request sets MergeDecisionDate = now, which closes the rows of earlier cycles. Decisions: Confirm / Reject / Remerge (codes CONFIRMED / REJECTED / REMERGE). A Group Steward Reject or Remerge in this cycle sets GROUP_REVIEW (Group Steward Review view, not published until demerged); any other completed cycle sets CONFIRMED. GROUP_REVIEW is kept until the composition changes. Only a merge done by a steward (a user with a Steward role, e.g. in the Duplicate Manager or the customer stepper) can request approval; batches from integration users (e.g. CRM loads) keep the published approval state (Prev* lookups). MergeApprovalStatus: a decision of this cycle (cluster stewards and/or Group Steward, written at the end of ClusterMergeApproval) = CONFIRMED. Otherwise: not merged (masters count <= 1) or single cluster = NOT_REQUIRED; same composition as already requested/approved (ApprovalMastersCount) = unchanged; merge done by a Group Steward = CONFIRMED; any other merge = PENDING with ApprovalRequestedBatchID = current batch (starts ClusterMergeApproval). Final merge decision of the latest approval cycle. Open rows = MergeApprovalLogs with DecisionTimestamp after MergeDecisionDate. A Group Steward row wins; otherwise the latest cluster decision (clusters agree, or the Group Steward would have decided). ApprovalCheck: 1 = merge approved, 0 = rejected. Every branch returns text (like BranchQualifier); Semarchy casts it to the boolean column. Value kept until the next cycle.
enrichers.label: Evaluate Merge Decision from Merge Approval Logs

semQlEnricherExpressions.expression:
CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) = 'PENDING' AND (LkpCycleStatus IS NOT NULL OR ANY MergeApprovalLog HAVE ((CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE')))
         AND COALESCE(LkpCycleDecision, LOOKUP FIRST UPPER(Decision)
             FROM MergeApprovalLog
             WHERE (CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE')
             ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(ReviewerRole) = 'MDM_GROUP_STEWARD' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, DecisionTimestamp DESC
             END) = 'CONFIRMED'
    THEN '1'
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) = 'PENDING' AND (LkpCycleStatus IS NOT NULL OR ANY MergeApprovalLog HAVE ((CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE')))
    THEN '0'
    WHEN ApprovalCheck = 'true' THEN '1'
    WHEN ApprovalCheck = 'false' THEN '0'
END

CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) = 'PENDING' AND (LkpCycleStatus IS NOT NULL OR ANY MergeApprovalLog HAVE ((CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE'))) THEN COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(LkpCycleDecisionOn, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), LOOKUP MAX DecisionTimestamp FROM MergeApprovalLog WHERE (CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE') END)
    WHEN COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) IS NULL OR COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) <= 1 OR (CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntMT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntIZ IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntLG IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntCO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntPT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntDC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 1 THEN MergeDecisionDate
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PENDING', 'GROUP_REVIEW') AND COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) = COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) THEN MergeDecisionDate
    WHEN SEM_INSTR(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, ''), 'MDM_Group_Steward') > 0 THEN MergeDecisionDate
    WHEN SEM_INSTR(UPPER(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, '')), 'STEWARD') = 0 THEN MergeDecisionDate
    ELSE DATE_TRUNC('second', NOW())
END

CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) = 'PENDING' AND (LkpCycleStatus = 'GROUP_REVIEW' OR ANY MergeApprovalLog HAVE ((CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(ClusterCode) = 'GROUP' AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('REJECTED', 'REMERGE'))) THEN 'GROUP_REVIEW'
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) = 'PENDING' AND (LkpCycleStatus IS NOT NULL OR ANY MergeApprovalLog HAVE ((CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate IS NULL OR DecisionTimestamp > CustomerLegalAccount.MergeDecisionDate) AND UPPER(Decision) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'REMERGE'))) THEN 'CONFIRMED'
    WHEN OutstandingCheckResult = 'YES' AND SEM_INSTR(UPPER(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, '')), 'STEWARD') > 0 AND COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) > 1 AND (COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) IS NULL OR COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) <> COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount)) THEN 'OUTSTANDING_BLOCKED'
    WHEN COALESCE(OutstandingCheckResult, 'REFRESH') = 'REFRESH' AND SEM_INSTR(UPPER(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, '')), 'STEWARD') > 0 AND COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) > 1 AND (COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) IS NULL OR COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) <> COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount)) THEN 'OUTSTANDING_REFRESH'
    WHEN COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) IS NULL OR COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) <= 1 OR (CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntMT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntIZ IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntLG IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntCO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntPT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN GrpActiveBuCntDC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 1 THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED'
    WHEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus) IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PENDING', 'GROUP_REVIEW') AND COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(PrevApprovalMastersCount, '9999999999'), ApprovalMastersCount) = COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(LkpMastersCount, '9999999999'), MastersCount) THEN COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus)
    WHEN SEM_INSTR(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, ''), 'MDM_Group_Steward') > 0 THEN 'CONFIRMED'
    WHEN SEM_INSTR(UPPER(COALESCE(:V_USER_ROLES, '')), 'STEWARD') = 0 THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(PrevApprovalStatus, MergeApprovalStatus), 'NOT_REQUIRED')
    ELSE 'PENDING'

enrichers.description: Customer contacts only. After consolidation, a mobile, telephone or business phone that is still digits only (no +) gets the dial code of the parent customer registration country (Country Reference DialCode). Numbers that already start with that code just get the +. When the customer has no registration country, a UAE number starting with 0 gets +971. Placeholders such as +971 alone are not changed.
enrichers.label: Default Contact Phone Country Code

semQlEnricherExpressions.expression:
CASE
  WHEN Mobile IS NULL OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(Mobile, '^[0-9]{7,15}$') THEN Mobile
  WHEN FID_Cgid IS NULL AND FID_CustomerOrgAssignment IS NULL THEN Mobile
  WHEN COALESCE(Cgid.RegistrationCountry.DialCode, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.RegistrationCountry.DialCode) IS NOT NULL THEN
    CASE
      WHEN Mobile LIKE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(Cgid.RegistrationCountry.DialCode, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.RegistrationCountry.DialCode), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '%' AND LENGTH(Mobile) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(Cgid.RegistrationCountry.DialCode, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.RegistrationCountry.DialCode), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 7 THEN '+' || Mobile
      ELSE '+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(Cgid.RegistrationCountry.DialCode, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.RegistrationCountry.DialCode), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || REGEXP_REPLACE(Mobile, '^0+', '')
    END
  WHEN COALESCE(Cgid.FID_RegistrationCountry, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.FID_RegistrationCountry) IS NULL
    THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(Mobile, '^0([1-9][0-9]{7,8})$', '+971\1')
  ELSE Mobile
END

CASE

  WHEN COALESCE(Cgid.FID_RegistrationCountry, CustomerOrgAssignment.CustomerLegalAccount.FID_RegistrationCountry) IS NULL
    THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumber, '^0([1-9][0-9]{7,8})$', '+971\1')
  ELSE TelephoneNumber
END

        ELSE '+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(BusinessPhone, '^(([^0-9/]*[0-9]){7,}[^0-9/]*)[/\n,;].*$', '\1'), '[^0-9+A-Za-z]', '', 'g'), '^0+', '')
      END
    , '^\+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '([0-9]{9,})$', '+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '\1')
    , '^\+971971([0-9]{8})$', '+971\1')
    , '^\+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '0+', CASE WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = '39' THEN '+390' ELSE '+' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TelephoneNumberCountryCode, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') END)
  ELSE
    REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(BusinessPhone, '^(([^0-9/]*[0-9]){7,}[^0-9/]*)[/\n,;].*$', '\1'), '[^0-9+A-Za-z]', '', 'g'), '^00', '+')
    , '^\+(\d{2,3})\1(\d{9,})$', '+\1\2')
    , '^\+([17])\1(\d{10,})$', '+\1\2')
    , '^\+971971(\d{8,})$', '+971\1')
END

matchRules.condition:
Record1.FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL
AND Record2.FID_Cgid IS NOT NULL
AND Record1.FID_Cgid = Record2.FID_Cgid
AND Record1.EnrichedAddress IS NOT NULL
AND Record2.EnrichedAddress IS NOT NULL
AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.EnrichedAddress)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.EnrichedAddress))
AND (Record1.AddressUsageCode IS NULL OR Record2.AddressUsageCode IS NULL OR Record1.AddressUsageCode = Record2.AddressUsageCode)
matchRules.label: Same customer + same enriched address (and same usage type when both have one) - merges duplicate addresses left behind after a customer-level merge (auto-merge)

matchRules.condition:
Record1.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record2.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record1.FID_SupplierSite = Record2.FID_SupplierSite
AND Record1.FID_CountryCode IS NOT NULL AND Record1.FID_CountryCode = Record2.FID_CountryCode
AND Record1.AddressLine1 IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.AddressLine1)) = UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.AddressLine1))
AND UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(Record1.AddressLine2, ''))) = UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(Record2.AddressLine2, '')))
AND Record1.CityNormalised IS NOT NULL AND Record1.CityNormalised = Record2.CityNormalised
matchRules.label: MAT-ADR-01 Same supplier site + country + address line 1-2 + city (auto-merge)

matchRules.condition:
Record1.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record2.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record1.FID_SupplierSite = Record2.FID_SupplierSite
AND Record1.PoBox IS NOT NULL AND Record1.PoBox = Record2.PoBox
AND Record1.CityNormalised IS NOT NULL AND Record1.CityNormalised = Record2.CityNormalised

matchRules.condition:
Record1.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record2.FID_SupplierSite IS NOT NULL
AND Record1.FID_SupplierSite = Record2.FID_SupplierSite
AND Record1.FID_CountryCode IS NOT NULL AND Record1.FID_CountryCode = Record2.FID_CountryCode
AND Record1.AddressLine1 IS NOT NULL AND Record2.AddressLine1 IS NOT NULL
AND SEM_EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY(UPPER(BTRIM(Record1.AddressLine1 || ' ' || COALESCE(Record1.AddressLine2, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(Record1.AddressLine3, ''))), UPPER(BTRIM(Record2.AddressLine1 || ' ' || COALESCE(Record2.AddressLine2, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(Record2.AddressLine3, '')))) >= 85
AND Record1.CityNormalised IS NOT NULL AND Record2.CityNormalised IS NOT NULL
AND SEM_EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY(Record1.CityNormalised, Record2.CityNormalised) >= 90
